caption: The drawing features a sleeveless vest or tunic, predominantly colored in a deep purple with gold decorative trim. The garment is designed to be worn over other clothing and features a V-shaped neckline with three parallel bands of gold trim running vertically down the center and around the neck opening. Similar gold trim also outlines the vest’s bottom hem and forms the edge of two large, symmetrical pockets placed on each side of the lower front, each pocket having an angular gold-trimmed flap detail. The vest is shaped to fit closely at the waist and has a slight flare at the hem. On the right side of the image, there is a lightly sketched line drawing of the same vest shown from the back, providing a simple outline of its structure. Below the colored illustration, the name "Louis Maldarelli" and the date "May 17th 1927" are inscribed in the lower left-hand corner. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Waistcoat
